topics.name: Canonical Source Role Identity
topics.purpose: Define explicit source roles such as bootstrap authority, definition, generated projection, history, evidence and runtime state so authority never derives from file placement alone.

semantics.role_rule: Every canonical artifact declares exactly one source_role allowed by the root Contract Format.
semantics.definition_rule: definition participates in active semantic definition when otherwise accepted and reachable.
semantics.projection_rule: derived_projection is generated/derived and never becomes semantic owner.
semantics.history_rule: historical_or_migration is preserved but excluded from active semantic competition.
semantics.candidate_rule: Candidate is lifecycle/change state, not a Contract Format 1.4 source_role value.
semantics.runtime_rule: Runtime state/evidence is not a Contract Format 1.4 canonical source_role and cannot become definition by persistence.
semantics.authority_rule: Source role is explicit semantics, not inferred solely from directory.
semantics.membership_registry_rule: membership_registry indexes membership without absorbing member semantics.
semantics.boundary_master_rule: boundary_master declares canonical boundary/entry references without absorbing child semantics.
semantics.reconciliation_rule: reconciliation records/defines reconciliation semantics and never wins source precedence by recency.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority, canonical contract sources, generated projections, historical artifacts and runtime state remain separate identities/roles; no file becomes authoritative merely by name, path order, timestamp or discovery order.
Candidate canonical changes remain inert until exact format validation, identity/reference resolution, semantic diff, applicable governance/authorization and repository acceptance succeed.

hard_gates.condition: generated projection treated as canonical definition
runtime state becomes source of truth
